name: Homeschooling
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital responsibility of parents to instruct their children in the knowledge and love of God, as seen in the command to love the Lord with all heart, soul, and might (Deuteronomy 6:5) and the charge to make God's laws known to the next generation (Psalms 78:5). This instruction includes guiding children away from ungodly influences (Psalms 1:1) and faithfully teaching them according to godly wisdom (Proverbs 1:8; Proverbs 22:6). While believers remain in the world, they are called to pray for their protection from evil (John 17:15), underscoring the importance of nurturing a Christ-centered environment, which homeschooling can provide by enabling parents to personally shepherd their children's spiritual and moral growth.
